messages:
Track when each task was created and last changed

Add createdAt/updatedAt (ISO-8601) to Task. Since src/domain/ may not
read the clock (r3-no-clock-or-randomness), the current time is passed
into add/complete/reopen/rename/tag/untag as a `now` parameter, the
same pattern already used for task ids.
